# TeslaSync db-refactor — Per-Phase Runner Commands
# Run one phase at a time. Each command is independent and resumable
# (skips prompts already in logs/done.txt).
#
# To run an entire phase end-to-end, copy a single line below and execute
# it in PowerShell from the repo root (D:\repos\teslasync).

# ── Phase 3 — Schema (28 prompts) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-3-schema

# ── Phase 4 — Migration assembly (varies) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-4-migration

# ── Phase 5 — Go models + repos (71 prompts) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-5-go-models

# ── Phase 6 — Write path / telemetry handler (32 prompts) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-6-write-path

# ── Phase 7 — Frontend types + hooks + pages (44 prompts) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-7-frontend ***

# ── Phase 8 — Helm + docker-compose cutover (3 prompts) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-8-helm-docker

# ── Phase 9 — Acceptance gates (25 prompts) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-9-acceptance ***

# ── Phase 5b — Consumer rewire CORRECTIVE (26 prompts) ──
# Addresses the falsely-green Phase 9 gates. Rewires 13 legacy consumers that
# still reference deleted model fields (Alert, Settings, AlertRule.Type,
# Automation.TriggerConfig/AutoDisabled, Geofence.Latitude/Longitude) and
# hardens the runner to fail-closed on EXIT=/STATUS=BLOCKED/[FAIL] markers.
# Prompts 00-03 are owner-approval ADRs — they emit STATUS=BLOCKED-PENDING-
# OWNER-APPROVAL and stop. Approve each ADR in-file before continuing.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-5b-consumer-rewire

# ── Phase 5c — Fixup (15 prompts) ──
# Fixes the 9 files still broken after Phase 5b (12/26 prompts were BLOCKED).
# Root causes: deleted parsers in validate.go, missing AutomationFull accessors,
# missing Geofence centroid, dirty-tree blocks, uncommitted changes.
# Also hardens the runner to stop marking BLOCKED prompts as DONE.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-5c-fixup

# ── Phase 5d — Final fixup (6 prompts) ──
# Fixes the last 2 broken files: location.go (Geofence.Radius) and
# api_call_log_repo.go (field name mismatches). Then runs build/vet/test gates.
# Runner now has fail-closed log-gate from Phase 5c.14.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-5d-final

# ── Phase 5e — Full cascade fix (11 prompts) ──
# Fixes charging_repo.go (Layer 1, blocks database pkg) then 7 cascade files
# in api/worker (alert_handler, telemetry_alerts, webhook_handler, worker,
# rule_engine, telemetry_sessions, doc.go). Then build/vet/test gates.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-5e-cascade

# ── Phase 5f — Repository layer rewire (16 prompts) ──
# Fixes 13 broken database repos (drive, vehicle, geofence, trip + 9 Tesla*
# RawJSON removals) that were hidden behind Go's "too many errors" limit.
# Each prompt has exact field mappings (old→new, or DELETE).
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-5f-repos

# ── Phase 5g — Consumer layer rewire (24 prompts) ──
# Final pass: 20 consumer files (api handlers, export, service, automation,
# worker) that reference old Drive/ChargingSession/Vehicle/PollingConfig fields.
# Found via comprehensive grep, not limited by Go's "too many errors".
# Each prompt has exact field mapping tables.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-5g-consumers

# ── Phase 5h — Final build fix (4 prompts) ──
# Last file: automation/engine.go (12 errors — Automation→AutomationFull).
# Then build/vet/test gates. After this, go build ./... should be GREEN.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-5h-final

# ── Phase 6 — Batch build fix (6 prompts) ──
# Different approach: batch by package instead of one-file-at-a-time.
# Prompt 00: telemetry_handler.go alone (187 errors).
# Prompt 01: all 27 other api handlers (~177 errors).
# Prompt 02: cmd/automation-worker/main.go (10 interface errors).
# Then build/vet/test gates.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-6-batch-fix

# ── Test-Fix Iteration 1 — Runtime errors from signal replay (8 prompts) ──
# Fixes 9 runtime errors found by replaying 6,672 prod signals against local Docker.
# Column renames (power→power_kw, end_date→end_ts), missing tables, CHECK constraint
# violations, NULL constraint on in-progress drives, fsm_type removal.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase test-fix-iteration-1

# ── Test-Fix Iteration 2 — Remaining runtime errors (7 prompts) ──
# Down from 3,429 → 153 errors after iteration 1. Fixes: live_state signal map
# (hvac_power, driver_seat_belt, speed), fsm_instance_id, predictor/trip start_date/distance.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase test-fix-iteration-2

# ── Test Quality — Fix broken tests + schema validation (9 prompts) ──
# Part A: Fix 5 broken _test.go files (vet errors on old model fields).
# Part B: Add schema_test.go (verify SQL columns against DB schema).
# Part C: Add signal→column map test (verify live_state_repo mappings).
# Requires local Docker Postgres running (localhost:5432).
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase test-quality

# ── Test-Fix Iteration 3 — Frontend crash + residual SQL + maintenance (7 prompts) ──
# Frontend .includes() crash, trip charge_energy_added→energy_added_kwh,
# created_at→ts in positions/api_call_logs, missing matviews, partition fix.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase test-fix-iteration-3

# ── Test-Fix Iteration 4 — Last 3 runtime errors (5 prompts) ──
# distance→distance_mi in stats, vehicle_config_snapshots missing table,
# speed→speed_mph in position compression. Targeting ZERO errors.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase test-fix-iteration-4

# -- Test Fix Iteration 5 (7 prompts) --
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase test-fix-iteration-5

# -- Test Fix Iteration 6 (7 prompts) --
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase test-fix-iteration-6

# -- Test Fix Iteration 7 (5 prompts) --
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase test-fix-iteration-7

# ── Phase 12 — Signal Pipeline: Redis hot cache + signal_history hypertable (7 prompts) ──
# PA-level architecture fix: solves Tesla delta-encoding missing context problem.
# Converts signal_history to hypertable, adds Redis HSET cache, adds point-in-time
# reconstruction for drive/charge completion. No new infrastructure needed.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-12-signal-pipeline

# ── Phase 13 — Anti-Pattern Cleanup: centralize constants, eliminate duplication (10 prompts) ──
# Deep audit found 18+ anti-patterns: hardcoded domain constants in .tsx files,
# duplicate helper functions, scattered signal→column mappings, magic timing numbers,
# duplicate types/interfaces, and string enum literals. This phase centralizes
# everything into single sources of truth.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-13-anti-pattern-cleanup

# ── Phase 14 — Unified Signal Pipeline: PA architecture (18 prompts) ──
# Replaces Phase 12 + absorbs Future-1 unit normalization (19 prompts).
# Single signal_log hypertable + Redis HSET replaces 12 snapshot tables.
# Clean break: drop legacy tables, no data migration, fresh start.
# Fixes core missing context problem, unit normalization, session recovery,
# DB outage resilience, and signal name change handling.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-14-unified-signal-pipeline

# ── Phase 15 — Phase 14 Fixup: remaining dropped-table refs (7 prompts) ──
# Fixes 7 remaining refs to dropped tables that Phase 14 agent missed:
# battery_snapshots in energy_repo/maintenance_worker/backup, vehicle_live_state
# in range_projection_handler, fsm_type migration, stale test fields.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-15-phase14-fixup

# ── Phase 16 — Data Gaps: replace empty TODO stubs with real signal_log queries (4 prompts) ──
# Battery health trend was replaced with empty arrays by Phase 14 agent.
# Dead snapshot dispatch functions left as no-op comments. This phase fills the gaps.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-16-data-gaps

# ── Phase 17 — Security & Reliability Hardening (10 prompts) ──
# SQL injection in backup, plaintext token fallback, incomplete backup status,
# credential leaks in query strings, SSE reconnect death spiral, ungraceful shutdown,
# silent write-buffer drops, competing config systems, critical-path test coverage.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-17-security-reliability

# ── Phase 18 — Auth Unification (7 prompts) ──
# Replace scattered auth (Authentik JWT exchange, API key query params, frontend SSE
# token fetch) with provider-agnostic ForwardAuth header check. One env var:
# FORWARD_AUTH_HEADER. Works with Authentik, Authelia, oauth2-proxy, Keycloak, etc.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-18-auth-unification

# ── Future-1 — Unit normalization (19 prompts) ──
# Stamps per-row unit columns (distance_unit, temp_unit, pressure_unit) on all
# measurement tables so historical data is self-describing. Frontend converts
# between car's GUI unit and user's TeslaSync display preference.
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase future-1-unit-normalization

# ── Phase 10 — Staging soak (3 prompts) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-10-staging-soak

# ── Phase 11 — Production cutover (1 prompt) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Phase phase-11-prod-cutover

# ── Rollback (use only on abort, not part of normal flow) ──
& "D:\repos\teslasync\.github\prompts\db-refactor\run-prompts.ps1" -Single "99-rollback.prompt.md"

# ── Useful flags ──
# Add  -DryRun                    to preview the order without executing
# Add  -Reset                     to wipe logs/done.txt and re-run from prompt 01
# Add  -Single "NN-name.prompt.md" to run one prompt only (searches all phases)
# Add  -Model "claude-opus-4.7"   to override the default model
